description.en: An everyday reminder of love, affection and support, this pendant in 18 karat gold is the perfect gift. It is available with the gemstone of your choice, but strong also on its own. Here pictured with a garnet, the birthstone of January.  Contact me, together we will find the right gemstone for you.
